profileLabel: Center-left economics (medium confidence); strongly election-access-oriented, institution-supporting
summary: Quezon City 6th District representative with 157 principal-authored bills. Authored voting-access and automation measures (absentee, alternative voting, automated barangay elections), Comelec field-office strengthening, police dashcams, equal spousal rights, a universal senior pension, estate tax abolition and a higher income-tax exemption.
caveat: Family-law and gender-equality bills form one issue, so social values are left unscored. Economic score mixes a universal pension with estate tax abolition.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored universal senior social pension (-3) against estate tax abolition (+3) and higher income-tax exemption with graduated rates (-2), averaged as tax (+1). Mixed distributional signals.
